latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Image to Video Maker Free — Convert Photos into MP4 Videos.

- Instantly convert uploaded images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF) into MP4 slideshow videos with transitions and music, no editing experience required.
- Simple authentication: get a free, 7-day token with 100 credits automatically on first use.
- Cloud rendering on GPU nodes—just upload images and describe your desired video; processing takes 30–90 seconds.
- Supports common video, audio, and image formats; up to 200MB per file.
- Export, credits check, and session state all accessible via simple commands.
- Clear error handling guides users through file issues, token problems, and plan restrictions.
